user.title: Energy settlement
user.description: Choose the meters this metering point is settled on. Prices and contract terms can be edited afterwards.

data_description.import_entity: A cumulative kWh sensor, not a power sensor.
data_description.export_entity: Leave empty if there is no generation.

data_description.allowance_basis: Whether the allowance is spent by everything withdrawn, or only by what is left after generation is netted off. The two differ sharply for a household that both draws and generates a lot.
data_description.mode: Szaldó nets generation against consumption. It closes ten years after commissioning, after which settlement is gross.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Set the prices in force from a chosen day. Leave the date at today for a change from now, or set it back to correct something noticed late. Prices already effective on that day are replaced.

data_description.feed_in: Paid for generation that netting cannot absorb. Typically a fraction of the price the same kWh costs to buy.

remove_price.title: Remove a price change
remove_price.description: Drops a price change added with the wrong date.

close_settlement.name: Close settlement period
close_settlement.description: Starts a new settlement period on the day the meter was read. The boundary follows the reading, not the calendar.
